name: Amiasea Workspace Engine
onCreateCommand: pwsh -NoProfile -Command '$modulePath = Join-Path ([Environment]::GetFolderPath("UserProfile")) "Documents/PowerShell/Modules/AmiaseaWorkspace"; New-Item -ItemType Directory -Path $modulePath -Force | Out-Null; Copy-Item .devcontainer/AmiaseaWorkspace.psd1, .devcontainer/AmiaseaWorkspace.psm1, .devcontainer/Workspace.Discovery.ps1, .devcontainer/Workspace.Provisioning.ps1 -Destination $modulePath -Force'
